name: Kurihara Maron
source:
Older loli heroine.

The former student council president with petite figure and a bit spoiled. She's actually a genius, but has no determination. She always playing around because for her, the exams are easy to do. She suffers from not being treated as an adult due to her undeveloped appearance. Has strong sex urge and often masturbate herself while watching AVs.

"Maron is the older sister! Ehhen♪"
